result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. Your example would come out as T-3, T-5, T-2, T-4, T-1. I didn't add a test for this order. The existing test suite (`mvn -q -o test`) passes.

The change is in `DataStore.findOpenSupportTicketsOfCustomersInRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. It now uses the same `highestPriorityFirst()` ordering as the sales rep's list, and I updated its comment to match. Closed tickets and tickets from other regions are filtered out as before. The region overview is the only caller of this method, so nothing else changes. I haven't committed anything.
